cues.en: I think one of the things that really separates us from the high primates is that
cues.zh: 我觉得真正把人类和高灵长类动物区分开的一点是

cues.en: we're tool builders. And I read a
cues.zh: 我们会制造工具。我读过一项

cues.en: study that measured the efficiency of locomotion
cues.zh: 研究，测量了地球上各种物种

cues.en: for various species on the planet.
The condor used the least energy to move a kilometer,
cues.zh: 秃鹫移动一公里消耗的能量最少，

cues.en: humans came in with a rather unimpressive showing about a third of the way down the list. It was not
cues.zh: 人类的表现相当不起眼，排在名单大约三分之一的位置。这可不是

cues.en: too proud of a showing for the crown of creation.
cues.zh: 什么值得万物之灵骄傲的表现。

cues.en: that didn't look so good, but then somebody at Scientific American had the insight to test the efficiency of locomotion for a man on a bicycle.
cues.zh: 那看起来不太妙，但后来《科学美国人》的某个人灵光一现，测试了人骑自行车的移动效率。

cues.en: And a man on a bicycle or a human on a bicycle blew the condor away, completely off the top of the charts.
cues.zh: 结果人骑自行车把秃鹫远远甩在后面，完全冲出了榜单顶端。

cues.en: And that's what a computer is to me. What a computer is to me is it's the most remarkable tool that we've ever come up with. And it's the equivalent of a bicycle for our minds.
cues.zh: 这就是计算机对我的意义。计算机对我来说，是我们发明过的最了不起的工具。它相当于我们大脑的自行车。
